# Enjoy a Long Stay on the Seafront of Marbella.

Enjoy the winter on the Costa del Sol by staying right by the sea at Puerto Azul Marbella, a highly valued option for senior tourism and long stays in Marbella.

### Why choose Puerto Azul for a long winter stay

- **Flat and Accessible Location:** Forget about the car. We are located on the seafront promenade, in a flat area with no hills, ideal for a morning walk.
- **24-Hour Security and Assistance:** Our reception is always open for anything you may need, giving you the peace of mind of a hotel with the freedom of a home.
- **Community and Peaceful Atmosphere:** A relaxed environment where you will share space with other guests looking for the same experience as you.

![Gallery 1](https://www.puertoazul.net/files-sbbasic/ba_apartpuertoazul_es/happy-senior-couple-strolling-along-seashore-spending-time-together-vacation-grey-haired-man-embracing-smiling-short-haired-woman-sunglasses-relationship-retirement-lifestyle-concept__1_.jpg?w=750&h=502.5)

### Details That Make the Difference

- **Fully Equipped Apartments:** Complete kitchens, housekeeping included and, above all, **beds designed for optimal rest**.
- **Guaranteed Accessibility:** Building with modern lifts and bathrooms with walk-in showers.
- **Connectivity:** High-speed Wi-Fi to stay in touch with family and international TV channels to feel at home.

![Gallery 2](https://www.puertoazul.net/files-sbbasic/ba_apartpuertoazul_es/casco_antiguo_de_marbella.png?w=750&h=502.5)

### Special Discounts for Long Stays

Save more the longer you stay with our winter offers:

- 7 nights or more → 5% discount
- 14 nights or more → 10% discount
- 21 nights or more → 15% discount
- 28 nights or more → 20% discount

[BOOK ON OUR OFFICIAL WEBSITE:](https://www.puertoazul.net/en/bookings)

![Your holidays are protected](https://www.puertoazul.net/files-sbbasic/ba_apartpuertoazul_es/img_2490-copy.jpg?w=750&h=502.5)

### Many of Our “Winter Guests” Return Year After Year

Every winter, we welcome many senior guests and long-stay travellers who return **season after season** to enjoy the tranquillity, the mild climate and the warm hospitality of Puerto Azul Marbella. Our “winter guests” find their second home by the sea here, and many **return for their stay** every year.

If you are looking for a place to feel at home during the colder months, **join our long-stay community** on the Costa del Sol.

- Arend, Netherlands: _"A clean apartment in a location close to the beach and the old town."_
- Eveline, Austria: _"Compared to last year: the Wi-Fi is faster and more stable, there are now warm duvets and a new air-conditioning unit (heating)."_
- Stephane, Canada: _"Impeccable reception. The location is ideal. The apartments are spacious and fully equipped with everything needed for cooking. The housekeeping staff are helpful and efficient. We loved our stay."_
- Seamus, Ireland: _"Returning guests. The staff are very friendly and helpful, as always. We will be back."_

Tripadvisor :

- [Monique and Brian, Ireland: _"A lovely holiday for walking and relaxing in the winter sun."_](https://www.tripadvisor.co/ShowUserReviews-g187439-d508274-r934116657-Puerto_Azul_Marbella-Marbella_Costa_del_Sol_Province_of_Malaga_Andalucia.html "(opens in new window)")

#### Frequently Asked Questions

###### Can I stay for several months during the winter?

Yes, Puerto Azul Marbella is open all year round and offers special conditions for extended stays during the winter season.

###### What services are included?

The accommodation includes a fully equipped apartment, WiFi 6 and LAN connection, daily housekeeping, 24-hour reception, a secure environment and access to 24-hour medical assistance.

###### Is it suitable for peaceful and safe long stays?

Yes, it is a highly valued option for guests seeking tranquillity, comfort and continuous assistance during extended stays.

![Gallery 4](https://www.puertoazul.net/files-sbbasic/ba_apartpuertoazul_es/view_from_front_sea_view.jpg?w=750&h=502.5)

### Marbella in Winter

Marbella in winter is the perfect destination for a peaceful and comfortable long stay. Thanks to its unique microclimate — with more than **320 days of sunshine** per year — nighttime temperatures rarely fall below 10ºC and daytime averages reach around 19ºC, allowing you to enjoy the outdoors even during the coolest months. Seafront walks, local gastronomy, hiking and cultural life without the summer crowds, with the **Old Town** within walking distance and close proximity to pharmacies and renowned health centres, make Marbella synonymous with well-being and quality of life all year round.
